verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ גֵּא֪וּת יְ֭הוָה לָבֵ֣שׁ הִתְאַזָּ֑ר עֹ֣ז תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל אַף־ תִּכּ֥וֹן בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ lā·ḇêš gê·’ūṯ Yah·weh lā·ḇêš hiṯ·’az·zār ‘ōz tê·ḇêl ’ap̄- tik·kō·wn bal- tim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: The LORD reigns He is robed in majesty the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength The world indeed is firmly established it cannot be moved
Your throne [was] established long ago You [are] from all eternity

verses.original: נְהָר֨וֹת׀ נָשְׂא֤וּ יְֽהוָ֗ה נְהָר֣וֹת נָשְׂא֣וּ קוֹלָ֑ם נְהָר֣וֹת יִשְׂא֖וּ דָּכְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·hā·rō·wṯ nā·śə·’ū Yah·weh nə·hā·rō·wṯ nā·śə·’ū qō·w·lām nə·hā·rō·wṯ yiś·’ū dā·ḵə·yām
verses.literal: The floodwaters have risen O LORD the rivers have raised their voice the seas lift up their pounding waves

verses.original: מִקֹּל֨וֹת׀ רַבִּ֗ים מַ֤יִם אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־ יָ֑ם יְהוָֽה׃ בַּמָּר֣וֹם אַדִּ֖יר
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·lō·wṯ rab·bîm ma·yim ’ad·dî·rîm miš·bə·rê- yām Yah·weh bam·mā·rō·wm ’ad·dîr
verses.literal: Above the roar of many waters the mighty breakers of the sea the LORD on high is majestic

verses.original: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ׀ מְאֹ֗ד נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ קֹ֑דֶשׁ נַאֲוָה־ לְבֵיתְךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ḏō·ṯe·ḵā mə·’ōḏ ne·’em·nū qō·ḏeš na·’ă·wāh- lə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh lə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Your testimonies are fully confirmed holiness adorns Your house O LORD for all the days to come
